title: Updates
intro: The Node-RED version installed for this instance and the latest release on npm.
checkFailedDetail: NRCC could not confirm the latest version. The update stays off until a check succeeds.

steps.backup: Back up the Node-RED data directory

completedDetail: Node-RED keeps running the previous version until it restarts. Restart it from Overview to run {{version}}.

failed.backup_failed: The pre-update backup could not be written, so nothing was installed.
failed.update_failed: npm did not install the new version, the installed version did not match, or npm audit found a critical vulnerability. Node-RED was not restarted, and the pre-update backup is in Backups.

imageGuidance: This NRCC installation is managed as an image. Update and redeploy the whole NRCC image with persistent data; do not use npm as a whole-product upgrade.
externalGuidance: Node-RED is managed outside NRCC. Update it using its owning deployment or package manager.
npmGuidance: This Node-RED installation supports an in-place npm update.
unknownGuidance: The installation method or current version is unknown, so in-place updates are disabled.
image_unsupported: Update and redeploy the whole NRCC image with persistent data to upgrade Node-RED.
external_unsupported: Update Node-RED using its external deployment or package manager.
confirmDescription: NRCC backs up the Node-RED data directory, then runs npm install -g node-red@{{latestVersion}} and checks the installed version. Node-RED keeps running {{currentVersion}} until you restart it. If the backup fails, nothing is installed.
historyHint: Each attempt starts with a backup of the Node-RED data directory. Restore one from Backups.
historyEmptyHint: Attempts appear here after you update Node-RED from this page.
availableAria: Update available, click to go to updates page
